text: The Pattern-weavers taught the camp to keep working after the singer left. These are the machines that farm, gather, craft, pump and keep watch while you are off doing something else.
- The **Grove Tender** plants and harvests a 9-by-9 bed.
- The **Wind Snare** picks dropped items up off the ground.
- The **Seal Loom** crafts one crafting-table recipe over and over.
- The **Tide Pump** moves fluid from one tank to another.
- The **Ward Drum** strikes hostiles that wander into camp.

**Each hand answers to a voice.** Keep a Resonance Totem of it within eight blocks or the hand stands idle and tells you which it wants: Earth for the Grove Tender and Wayanchor, Spirit for the Ward Drum, Hush Totem and Summoning Cradle, Water for the Tide Pump, Air for the Wind Snare and relays, Loom for the Seal Loom and Astral relays.

pages.title: Rules they all share
text: Each one draws Pulse from generators within **8 blocks** and only pays when it actually does something. An idle hand costs nothing.
A steady redstone signal, such as a lever, pauses it. A comparator reads what it is doing or how full it is; each entry says which.

The Seal Loom, Tide Pump, Wind Snare and Ward Drum can be ranked in Echo Attune, then Echo Bind, then Echo Manifest (see [Machine ranks](machine_ranks)). A ranked hand beats faster, every **85%**, **70%** or **55%** of a second, but the Pulse per job stays the same, so the lattice feels the extra speed.

pages.title: Keeping the camp
text: Other camp blocks look after the place itself rather than doing chores:
- A **Wayanchor** keeps a distant chunk awake.
- **Spirit Lanterns** and the [Pulse lights](pulse_lights) light the paths.
- A **Rain Chime** turns the weather into a redstone signal.
- An **Offering Table** is a 27-slot store beside a hearth.
Crouch and right-click any of them with this book when something will not start.
